ios.desc:
Can you outsmart Brownian motion? Dozens of collisions, one steel ball. From simple bounces to colorful chaos—physics has never been this addictive.
Brownian is a minimalist physics puzzle indie game that puts you in control of a steel ball inside a tube filled with colorful particles, just with one click. Your mission? Change every particle to the same color through calculated collisions.

SIMPLE TO LEARN, IMPOSSIBLE TO MASTER
• Tap and drag to release your steel ball
• Watch as realistic physics creates chain reactions
• Time your moves to beat the clock

PURE PHYSICS GAMEPLAY
• Brownian motion simulation
• Elastic collision mechanics
• Gravity-based challenges that test your precision

105 LEVELS OF ESCALATING CHALLENGE
• Start with 2 colors, progress to 8
• Earn up to 3 stars per level
• Unlock new challenges and soundtracks as you master the basics

MINIMALIST PERFECTION
• Clean and minimalist design
• Designed for one-handed play
• One-tap game mechanic
• Relaxing soundtrack

Every tap matters. Every collision counts. Can you master the simplicity of such complexity?

quotes.text:
I created a puzzle game inspired by the physics of Brownian motion: Brownian.
The design is as simple as it is effective: you can’t control the main sphere, only stop it, and your goal is to turn all the other particles the same color. Each round takes just a second to play, but it quickly becomes very strategic.
The game is completely free — a passion project made purely for fun. Let me know what you think!
The game is available on the App Store:
https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/brownian-game/id6755209801
and on the Play Store:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.brownian.game
